sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 818)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across two legendary live performances on the *Grand Ole Opry* (Hank Snow & Minnie Pearl; Marty Robbins & The Jordanaires for Prince Albert Tobacco in 1959), San Francisco police interrogation drama on *The Lineup* for Pabst Blue Ribbon, master-of-disguise investigations on *Mr. Chameleon* for Pepto-Bismol, Honoré de Balzac's French gothic mystery *La Grande Bretèche* on *The Mind's Eye*, and heartland counseling on *Aunt Mary*, Jane Morgan (1945), Karl Swenson (1951), Bill Johnstone (1951), and Marty Robbins & Hank Snow (1959):
